messages.text: Does the bitaxe gamma 602 work with harlo os or does it need to be the 601?

I don't want to guess on that one. The Gamma 602 and 601 use different control boards, and I'm not going to tell you a build runs on yours unless I'm sure, so I've passed it to JD, who handles the firmware side. He'll come back to you here or by email.

Fastest route if you don't want to wait: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate (JD). Harlo OS builds and release notes also live at harlolabs.com.

Which unit do you have already, 601 or 602?
Handed to the team · Firmware compatibility for Bitaxe Gamma 602 is not in the product facts and harl
JD has been pinged and can jump into this chat, so stay with me here if you can. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.
I have the 602 only, thanks for your help

Good to know, thanks. JD will confirm the 602 here or by email.

Before you go, one thing: what are you hoping Harlo OS gives you that your current firmware doesn't?
I was wanting to see the web interface it looks like it has more features than the original one

That makes sense, the dashboard is the main draw for most people who switch.

One more: is the extra you're after mostly the pool and tuning controls, or the monitoring side, charts and stats?
It’s a mix of everything but none of my other devices support it

Understood. Our own Harlo and Hammer miners ship with Harlo OS on them, so that's the simplest way to get the dashboard without fighting firmware on third-party boards. Happy to point you at the right one if you tell me your budget and where it would run.

And JD will confirm the 602 question here or by email.
